description: This is a Dart source file defining the PaymentFragment widget, which renders a payment options screen in a Flutter app. It includes UI components for wallet balance, QR code payment, and external app linking (Paytm, Mobikwik, Google Pay), along with methods for launching apps and showing dialogs.

classes.name: PaymentFragment
classes.description: Stateless widget representing the payment options and flow in the app.

methods.name: _buildPaymentTile
methods.description: Helper method to construct a payment method list tile with icon, name, link, color, and tap callback.

methods.name: _launchApp
methods.description: Attempts to launch an external app via URI scheme; shows fallback message if unsuccessful.

methods.name: _showPaymentDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for completing the payment, with success or failure options.
